canonical_schedule: 144 unique rule, guard, signal, date, and load combinations
early_medium_load_handling: Identical registered cases evaluated in temporary directories, then reused by the main schedule
repeat: Independent replay of the first date at 3500 orders with positive timing perturbation; all output bytes compared

choice_observations.selection: Before applying a single-crane decision, count feasible same-tier service jobs and the first feasible alternative without the duration key
choice_observations.followup: Keep the original allocation and check exact cost, truck time, ship clocks, and demand manifest against the original run
choice_observations.use: Descriptive mechanism check only; no new policy arm, model fitting, or case selection
